cohort: The study included 803 mothers and 811 neonates who were not admitted to the neonatal ICU, recruited from a postnatal care ward of a tertiary care centre.
finding: Twin pregnancy and caesarean section delivery were associated with a significant fall in exclusive breastfeeding rates, while gestational age, maternal parity, and maternal education showed no significant effect.
mod_finding: In vaginal deliveries, 86.20% of neonates were exclusively breastfed, compared to 55.53% in caesarean deliveries, demonstrating a significant negative association between caesarean section and exclusive breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in the postnatal care ward, shortly after birth.
gest_age: Included both term and preterm neonates.
